meta.name: engine_matrix
meta.description: 160 (plan F-csak-gpt, Sz0): every JEV call site with its counterpart without JEV (GPT, or the code), or a stated exception, and the tests that cover it. `python -m jav.cli preflight` checks four rules (jav/engine_matrix.py): every call-site config and every module that asks JEV is listed; each site has exactly one of `gpt` and `exception`, with existing modules and an allowed kind; each names tests that exist; nothing listed is gone.

changelog.note: 208 (plan G-process-core R2): the measurement's modules moved into jav/evals/, with the three stand-alone tools from jav/experiments/; the paths here follow them, nothing else changed.
208 (plan G-process-core R2): the flows' modules moved into jav/flows/; the paths here follow them, nothing else changed.
208 (plan G-process-core R2): the AI layer's modules moved into jav/ai/; the paths here follow them, nothing else changed.
208 (plan G-process-core R2): the document reading's modules moved into jav/documents/; the paths here follow them, nothing else changed.
208 (plan G-process-core R2): the quotes domain's modules moved into jav/domains/quotes/; the paths here follow them, nothing else changed.
208 (plan G-process-core R2): the finance domain's modules moved into jav/domains/finance/; the paths here follow them, nothing else changed.
208 (plan G-process-core R2): the email domain's modules moved into jav/domains/email/; the paths here follow them, nothing else changed.
204 (R1c): the native reader's JEV-only field-selection arm removed; no flow or measurement called it, only its test.

204 (R1b, the owner's decision to archive every experimental and learning branch): the five learning sites (document_learning, email_learning, claim_assessment, grounded_claims, source_find) and the now unused `experimental` exception kind removed; their code is in the local tag archive/kiserletek-204.
200 (the pinned JEV version): jav/jev_version.py resolves the provider's moving name with the adapter's model probe; it asks no judgement, so it is a routing module
197 (plan 197 K2b): the taught ticket candidate's verification site, as the converted packs'
191 (plan F-quote-package B4b): the quote match call site, with GPT's same questions as its counterpart without JEV
190 (plan 189 A2e): the quote request's verification call site, with the code's own source check as its counterpart without JEV
173 (plan 170, E0b): the before/after replay as a routing module; it asks nothing itself
160-B Sz0: first version, 26 call-site configs, 3 sites without a config, 5 experimental branches, 8 routing modules

exception_kinds.replaced: Without JEV another path does the step; the reason names it.
exception_kinds.skipped: Without JEV the step is left out; the code's own checks stay.
exception_kinds.measurement_only: A measurement of JEV itself, or a comparison arm no flow calls; it means nothing without JEV.

A calibration probe of the JEV verification itself; it means nothing without JEV.

routing.jav/flows/flow.py: the invoice flow: asks the select and verify call sites, turns a JEV failure into a to-do, and without JEV runs the G path with the code's check
routing.jav/flows/flow_detect.py: the detection flow: asks detect and detect_detail, or GPT without JEV
routing.jav/domains/email/flow_email.py: the email flow: asks email_intent, or GPT without JEV
routing.jav/ai/jev_budget.py: fits a request to the call site's size budget and asks it once more on a token error
routing.jav/ai/engine.py: switches JEV off in every step of a flow built without JEV
routing.jav/evals/evals.py: the golden and determinism measurements of the invoice flow (and the verifier probe, a site of its own)
routing.jav/evals/before_after_replay.py: the before/after replay: runs the existing processing with an adapter that reads the JEV answer cache; it asks nothing itself, and a question without an earlier answer is refused for want of a budget
routing.jav/ai/jev_version.py: the pinned JEV version: resolves the provider's moving name (jev-latest) with the adapter's model probe for the daily look; it asks no judgement, and processing without JEV never calls it
